name: prototype-compressor
title_zh: 单文件 HTML 原型里的图片压到能发出去
tagline_zh: 原型里塞了几十张 base64 截图，文件大到发不出微信、传不上预览环境。
tagline_en: Dozens of base64 screenshots bloat your prototype until it won't send. It re-encodes embedded PNG/JPEG to WebP.
desc_en: Compress embedded PNG/JPEG images in single-file HTML prototypes. Defaults to WebP quality 78 and a sibling .min.html file; supports explicit source overwrite.
why_zh: 默认不覆盖源文件，产物落在同目录 .min.html，对比体积后再决定要不要覆盖。质量、格式。
why_en: Writes to a sibling .min.html by default instead of overwriting, so you can compare sizes first. Quality, format, and output.
limit_zh: 只处理单文件 HTML 里 base64 内嵌的 PNG/JPEG，外链图片和 CSS 背景图一律不管。
limit_en: Only base64-embedded PNG/JPEG in single-file HTML; external images and CSS backgrounds are ignored. WebP breaks on old Safari and some mail clients.
title_en: Shrink embedded images in single-file HTML prototypes
